description: Get residential construction pipeline by geography: new starts, units under construction, and completed units. Returns housing supply and activity trends.

category_code.description: ASTARTS (annual rate, default), STARTS, COMPLETIONS, UNDERCONST, AUTHNOTSTD, or "ALL".

time.description: Month as "YYYY-MM" (e.g. "2026-04"), or "from 2026-01 to 2026-04" for a range. Defaults to the latest published month.

name: census_housing_starts
